Execution time for annual: (as of 7/2/2025)

Execution time for monthly: (as of 7/2/2025)

This markdown file performs QA on the following files:

-   Master database

-   CHP database

-   Generator file

-   Unit file

-   Plant file

-   Region aggregation files

-   Subregion file

-   All file comparison

-   Output file

Each QA step will return a list of of issues raised. If there are no issues in the step, nothing will be returned.

```{r}
#| label: load-libraries
#| message: false

library(dplyr) 
library(tidyr) 
library(readr) 
library(readxl) 
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

source("scripts/functions/function_temporal_res_cols.R")
temporal_res_cols <- create_temporal_res_cols(params$temporal_res)
```

# Master Database QA

## Compare plants between EIA and EPA

Check if any plants are only in the EPA data and not EIA data. These plants will be checked with EPA to see if there are any ORIS (plant ID) matches we should be making or if the plants should be deleted. We also check if there are any plants just in EIA-923 and not any other data sources.

```{r}
#| label: compare-eia-epa

# load in cleaned epa and eia data
epa <- 
  read_rds(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/clean_data/epa/{params$year}/epa_clean.RDS"))

eia_860 <- 
  read_rds(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/clean_data/eia/{params$year}/eia_860_clean.RDS")) 

eia_923 <- 
  read_rds(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/clean_data/eia/{params$year}/eia_923_clean.RDS")) 

# group data by distinct plant IDs
compare_plants <- 
  epa %>% 
  select(epa_plant_id = plant_id, plant_name) %>% distinct() %>% 
  full_join(eia_860$plant %>% select(plant_id) %>% distinct() %>% 
              mutate(eia_860_plant_id = plant_id), by = c("epa_plant_id" = "plant_id")) %>% 
  full_join(eia_923$generation_and_fuel_combined %>% 
              select(plant_id) %>% distinct() %>% 
              mutate(eia_923_plant_id = plant_id), by = c("epa_plant_id" = "plant_id"))

# identify plants only present in EPA data
check_compare_plants_epa <- 
  compare_plants %>% 
  filter(!is.na(epa_plant_id) & is.na(eia_860_plant_id) & is.na(eia_923_plant_id))

# print plants not in EIA
ifelse(nrow(check_compare_plants_epa) == 0, "Status: PASS - No plants in EPA not in EIA.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_compare_plants_epa)} plants in EPA not in EIA."))

knitr::kable(check_compare_plants_epa %>% 
               select(epa_plant_id, plant_name), caption = "EPA plants not in EIA")

# compare to EPA plants to delete in unit file
epa_plants_to_delete <-
  read_csv("data/1_production_model/static_tables/epa_plants_to_delete.csv")

only_in_epa <-
  check_compare_plants_epa %>%
  filter(!epa_plant_id %in% epa_plants_to_delete$`ORIS Code`)

# print plants not in epa_plants_to_delete
ifelse(nrow(only_in_epa) == 0, "Status: PASS - No plants in EPA not in list of EPA plants to delete.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(only_in_epa)} plants in EPA not in list of EPA plants to delete."))

knitr::kable(only_in_epa %>% 
               select(epa_plant_id, plant_name), caption = "EPA plants not in list of EPA plants to delete")

# check if any units are just in one EIA files and no other data files
only_in_eia_923 <- 
  compare_plants %>% 
  filter(!is.na(eia_923_plant_id), is.na(eia_860_plant_id), is.na(epa_plant_id))

# print plants not in epa_plants_to_delete
ifelse(nrow(only_in_eia_923) == 0, "Status: PASS - No plants in EIA-923 not in EPA or EIA-860 plants.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(only_in_eia_923)} plants in EIA not in EPA or EIA-860 plants. Check if they are retired."))

knitr::kable(only_in_eia_923 %>% 
               select(eia_923_plant_id), caption = "EIA-923 plants not in EPA or EIA-860 plants.")
```

# Generator File QA

Load generator file. Currently using data for eGRID `r params$year`.

```{r}
#| label: load-gen-file

generator_file <- 
  read_rds(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/outputs/{params$year}/{params$temporal_res}/generator_file_{params$temporal_res}.RDS"))

```

## Duplicate generators

Check if there are any duplicate generators. There should be zero.

```{r}
#| label: generator-duplicates 

check_gen_duplicates <- 
  generator_file %>% 
  select(plant_id, generator_id, plant_name) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(plant_id, generator_id) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1)

ifelse(nrow(check_gen_duplicates) == 0, "Status: PASS - No generator duplicates.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_gen_duplicates)} generators are duplicated."))

knitr::kable(check_gen_duplicates %>% 
               select(plant_id, generator_id, plant_name))

```

# Unit File QA

Load unit file.

Currently using preliminary data for eGRID `r params$year`.

```{r}
#| label: load-unit-file

unit_file <-
  read_rds(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/outputs/{params$year}/{params$temporal_res}/unit_file_{params$temporal_res}.RDS"))

```

## Prime mover, botfirty, and fuel type missing from EF table

Identify if any combinations are missing from NOx and SO2 EF table.

```{r}
#| label: check-ef-table

emission_factors_pu <- 
  read_csv("data/1_production_model/static_tables/emission_factors_physicalunits.csv")

emission_factors_hi <- 
  read_csv("data/1_production_model/static_tables/emission_factors_heatinput.csv")

emission_factors <- 
  rbind(emission_factors_pu, emission_factors_hi) %>% distinct()

fuel_type_category <- 
  read_csv("data/1_production_model/static_tables/fuel_type_categories.csv", 
           col_types = cols_only(combustion_fuels = "c")) 

combustion_fuels <- fuel_type_category[["combustion_fuels"]]

unit_pm_botfirty_fuel <- 
  unit_file %>% 
  select(prime_mover, botfirty, primary_fuel_type, contains("mass")) %>% 
  filter(primary_fuel_type %in% c(combustion_fuels, "OTH")) %>% 
  distinct()

ef_pm_botfirty_fuel <- 
  emission_factors %>% 
  select(prime_mover, botfirty, primary_fuel_type) %>% 
  mutate(botfirty = if_else(botfirty %in% c("N/A", "null"), NA_character_, botfirty)) %>% 
  distinct()

missing_from_ef <- 
  unit_pm_botfirty_fuel %>% anti_join(ef_pm_botfirty_fuel)

knitr::kable(missing_from_ef %>% 
               select(prime_mover, botfirty, primary_fuel_type) %>% 
               distinct() %>% 
               arrange(primary_fuel_type))
```

## EPA Boiler Firing Type

```{r}
#| label: unit-boiler-firing-type

epa <- read_rds(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/clean_data/epa/{params$year}/epa_clean_monthly.RDS")) 

xwalk_botfirty <- 
  read_csv("data/1_production_model/static_tables/xwalk_boiler_firing_type.csv") %>% 
  select(EPA, eGRID) %>% 
  drop_na()

check_epa_botfirty <- 
  epa %>% 
  left_join(xwalk_botfirty ,
            by = c("unit_type_abb" = "EPA")) %>% 
  mutate(botfirty = eGRID) %>% 
  select(unit_type_abb, botfirty) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(is.na(botfirty))

ifelse(nrow(check_epa_botfirty) == 0, "Status: PASS - All unit types in EPA are accounted for in xwalk_boiler_firing_type.csv.",
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_epa_botfirty)} boiler firing types need to be added to xwalk_boiler_firing_type.csv and updated to an abbreviation in data_clean_epa.R."))
  
knitr::kable(check_epa_botfirty %>% 
               select(epa_unit_type = unit_type_abb, botfirty))
```

## Heat input / emissions values for retired units

Check if any EPA units that retired in current data year have heat input / emission values.

```{r}
#| label: unit-values-retired

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  check_unit_retired_values <-  
    unit_file %>% 
    filter(capd_flag == "Yes" & operating_status == "RE" & 
             (heat_input > 0 | 
              heat_input_oz > 0 | 
              nox_mass > 0 |
              nox_oz_mass > 0 | 
              so2_mass > 0 |
              co2_mass > 0))
} else { 
  check_unit_retired_values <-  
    unit_file %>% 
    filter(capd_flag == "Yes" & operating_status == "RE" & 
             (heat_input > 0 | 
              nox_mass > 0 |
              so2_mass > 0 |
              co2_mass > 0))
  }

ifelse(nrow(check_unit_retired_values) == 0, 
       "Status: PASS - No units that are retired and have positive heat input or emissions.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_unit_retirement)} units that are retired and 
                   have positive heat input or emissions."))

knitr::kable(check_unit_retired_values %>% 
               select(plant_name, plant_id, unit_id))

```

## EPA ozone season reporter outliers

FLAG: This needs to be updated to match new monthly methodology.

Some EPA units only report their ozone season emissions, so we try to gap fill the remaining months with EIA data. In the source columns, we have an option that states this (i.e. "EIA non-ozone season distributed and EPA ozone season" for heat input and "Estimated using emissions factor and EIA data for non-ozone season and EPA ozone season emissions" or "Estimated based on unit-level NOx emission rates and EPA ozone season emissions" for annual NOx). We want to make sure that the NOx emissions we've assigned for these aren't extremely large outliers - especially compared to the ozone season values for NOx at the plant. So you'd filter the NOx source for these sources and then filter the NOx annual emissions from largest to smallest and see how those large ones compare to the ozone season NOx value. If super high we want to note that we need to look into that plant/unit.

```{r}
#| label: unit-nox-outliers
#| eval: false

check_unit_nox_outliers <- 
  unit_file %>% 
  filter(nox_source %in% 
           c("Estimated using emissions factor and EIA data for non-ozone season 
             and EPA ozone season emissions", 
             "Estimated based on unit-level NOx emission rates and EPA ozone season emissions")) %>%
  arrange(desc(nox_mass)) %>% 
  select(plant_name, plant_id, unit_id, nox_mass, nox_oz_mass)

knitr::kable(check_unit_nox_outliers)

```

## Ozone emissions and heat input

Ozone emissions and heat input values must not be greater than annual values.

```{r}
#| label: unit-ozone

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  check_unit_ozone <- 
    unit_file %>%
    filter((nox_oz_mass > nox_mass) | (heat_input_oz > heat_input))
  
    ifelse(nrow(check_unit_ozone) == 0, 
           "Status: PASS - All ozone emissions and heat input values are less than annual values.", 
            glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_unit_ozone)} units have heat input values greater than annual values.")) 
    
    knitr::kable(check_unit_ozone %>% 
                   select(plant_name, plant_id, unit_id, nox_oz_mass, nox_mass, heat_input_oz, heat_input))
} else { 
  print("Running monthly version so this does not apply.")}

```

## Duplicate units

Check if there are any duplicate units. There should be zero.

```{r}
#| label: unit-duplicates

check_unit_duplicates <- 
  unit_file %>% 
  select(plant_name, plant_id, unit_id, prime_mover) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  group_by(plant_id, unit_id, prime_mover) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1)

unit_duplicates_number <-
  check_unit_duplicates %>%
  distinct(unit_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

ifelse(nrow(check_unit_duplicates) == 0, "Status: PASS - No duplicate units.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(unit_duplicates_number)} units are duplicated."))

knitr::kable(unit_duplicates_number %>% 
               select(plant_name, plant_id, unit_id, prime_mover))
```

## Negative emissions values

Check if any emission values are negative. The emissions to check are:

-   unadjusted annual NOx

-   unadjusted ozone NOx

-   unadjusted annual SO2

-   unadjusted annual CO2

-   unadjusted annual Hg

```{r}
#| label: unit-negative-emissions

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") {
  check_unit_negative_emissions <-  
    unit_file %>% 
    filter(nox_mass < 0 |
            nox_oz_mass < 0 |
            so2_mass < 0 |
            co2_mass < 0 |
            hg_mass < 0)
  
  ifelse(nrow(check_unit_negative_emissions) == 0, "Status: PASS - No negative emissions.", 
          glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_unit_negative_emissions)} units have negative emissions."))
  
  knitr::kable(check_unit_negative_emissions %>% 
                 select(plant_name, plant_id, unit_id, nox_mass, nox_oz_mass, so2_mass, co2_mass))
} else { 
  check_unit_negative_emissions <-  
    unit_file %>% 
    filter(nox_mass < 0 |
           so2_mass < 0 |
           co2_mass < 0 |
           hg_mass < 0)
  
  ifelse(nrow(check_unit_negative_emissions) == 0, "Status: PASS - No negative emissions.", 
          glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_unit_negative_emissions)} units have negative emissions."))
  
  knitr::kable(check_unit_negative_emissions %>% 
                 select(month, plant_name, plant_id, unit_id, nox_mass, so2_mass, co2_mass))}
```

## Emissions from zero emission fuels

Check if there are positive emission values from zero-emission fuels. There should be zero. The emission values to check are:

-   unadjusted annual NOx

-   unadjusted ozone NOx

-   unadjusted annual SO2

-   unadjusted annual CO2

-   unadjusted annual Hg

```{r}
#| label: unit-zero-emissions

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  check_unit_zero_emissions <-  
    unit_file %>% 
    filter(primary_fuel_type %in% c("WAT", "WND", "SUN", "NUC") & 
                          (!is.na(nox_mass) | nox_mass > 0 |
                          !is.na(nox_oz_mass) | nox_oz_mass > 0 |
                          !is.na(so2_mass) | so2_mass > 0 |
                          !is.na(co2_mass) | co2_mass > 0 |
                          !is.na(hg_mass) | hg_mass > 0)) 
  
  ifelse(nrow(check_unit_zero_emissions) == 0, "Status: PASS - No positive emissions for zero emissions technologies.", 
          glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED {nrow(check_zero_emissions)} zero emission units have positive emissions."))
  
  knitr::kable(check_unit_zero_emissions %>% 
                 select(plant_name, plant_id, unit_id, primary_fuel_type, nox_mass, nox_oz_mass, so2_mass, co2_mass, hg_mass))
} else { 
  check_unit_zero_emissions <-  
    unit_file %>% 
    filter(primary_fuel_type %in% c("WAT", "WND", "SUN", "NUC") & 
                          (!is.na(nox_mass) | nox_mass > 0 |
                          !is.na(so2_mass) | so2_mass > 0 |
                          !is.na(co2_mass) | co2_mass > 0 |
                          !is.na(hg_mass) | hg_mass > 0)) 
  
  ifelse(nrow(check_unit_zero_emissions) == 0, "Status: PASS - No positive emissions for zero emissions technologies.", 
          glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED {nrow(check_zero_emissions)} zero emission units have positive emissions."))
  
  knitr::kable(check_unit_zero_emissions %>% 
                 select(month, plant_name, plant_id, unit_id, primary_fuel_type, nox_mass, so2_mass, co2_mass, hg_mass))
}
```

# Plant File QA

Load current year plant file and previous year plant file.

```{r}
#| label: load-plant-data

plant_file <- 
  read_rds(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/outputs/{params$year}/{params$temporal_res}/plant_file_{params$temporal_res}.RDS"))

plant_file_prev <- 
  read_excel(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/static_tables/historical_egrid/egrid{params$year - 1}_data.xlsx"), 
             sheet = glue::glue("PLNT{params$year_abbrev - 1}"), skip = 1) %>% 
              janitor::clean_names() %>% 
              rename("plant_id" = "orispl", 
                     "plant_name" = "pname", 
                     "lat_prev" = "lat", 
                     "lon_prev" = "lon", 
                     "chp_flag_prev" = "chpflag", 
                     "subrgn_prev" = "subrgn") %>%
  mutate(plant_id = as.character(plant_id))

```

## Difference in latitude and longitude

Check if plants have a difference in longitude and latitude in comparison to previous year data. This is checked to three decimal points.

```{r}
#| label: plant-lat-long

plant_file_lat_lon <- 
  plant_file %>% 
  select(plant_id, lat, lon) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(plant_file_prev %>% 
  select(plant_id, lat_prev, lon_prev), by = "plant_id") %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 3))

check_plant_lat_lon <- 
  plant_file_lat_lon %>%
  mutate(lat_diff = abs(lat - lat_prev), lon_diff = abs(lon - lon_prev)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(lat_diff) & !is.na(lon_diff) & !(lat_diff == 0) | !(lon_diff == 0))

ifelse(nrow(check_plant_lat_lon) == 0, "Status: PASS - All plants have the same lat/lon as previous year.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_lat_lon)} plants have different lat/lon than last year."))
  
knitr::kable(check_plant_lat_lon %>% 
               select(plant_id, lat, lat_prev, lat_diff, lon, lon_prev, lon_diff))

```

## CHP status change

Check if CHP status has changed from previous year.

```{r}
#| label: plant-chp-flag

plant_chp_flag <- 
  plant_file %>% 
  select(plant_id, chp_flag) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(plant_file_prev, by = c("plant_id")) %>% 
  mutate(chp_comparison = ifelse(chp_flag == chp_flag_prev, "Same", 
                                 "Changed")) 
  
check_plant_chp_flag <- 
  plant_chp_flag %>% 
  filter(chp_comparison == "Changed")
  
ifelse(nrow(check_plant_chp_flag) == 0, "Status: PASS - No CHP flags are different", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_chp_flag)} plants have different CHP flags than last year."))

knitr::kable(check_plant_chp_flag %>% 
               select(plant_id, chp_flag, chp_flag_prev))

```

## Different subregions

Check if any plants have changed subregion from previous year.

```{r}
#| label: plant-subregion

plant_subregion <-  
  plant_file %>% 
  select(plant_id, egrid_subregion) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(plant_file_prev, by = c("plant_id")) %>% 
  mutate(subrgn_comparison = ifelse(egrid_subregion == subrgn_prev, "Same", 
                                 "Changed"))
  
check_plant_subrgn <- 
  plant_subregion %>% 
  filter(subrgn_comparison == "Changed")
  
ifelse(nrow(check_plant_subrgn) == 0, "Status: PASS - No subregions are different", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_subrgn)} plants have different subregions than last year."))

knitr::kable(check_plant_subrgn %>% 
               select(plant_id, egrid_subregion, subrgn_prev))

```

## Missing Lat/Lon Values

```{r}
#| label: missing-lat-lon

```

## Historically Different Subregions

Check if any subregions are different from last year and include the subregion for the last two years.

```{r}
#| label: plant-subregion-hist-diffs
#| results: false

# read in plant file data from previous year
plant_file_prev_hist <- 
  read_excel(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/static_tables/historical_egrid/egrid{params$year - 1}_data.xlsx"), 
             sheet = glue::glue("PLNT{params$year_abbrev - 1}"), skip = 1) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  rename("plant_id" = "orispl", 
         "plant_name" = "pname", 
         "lat_prev" = "lat", 
         "lon_prev" = "lon", 
         "chp_flag_prev" = "chpflag", 
         "subrgn_prev" = "subrgn",
         "ba_name_prev" = "baname",
         "nerc_prev" = "nerc",
         "utlsrvid_prev" = "utlsrvid") %>% 
  mutate(plant_id = as.character(plant_id))

# read in plant file data from 2 years prior
plant_file_prev2_hist <- 
  read_excel(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/static_tables/historical_egrid/egrid{params$year - 2}_data.xlsx"), 
             sheet = glue::glue("PLNT{params$year_abbrev - 2}"), skip = 1) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  rename("plant_id" = "orispl", 
         "subrgn_prev2" = "subrgn") %>%
  select(plant_id, subrgn_prev2) %>% 
  mutate(plant_id = as.character(plant_id))

plant_subregion_hist <-  plant_file %>% 
  left_join(plant_file_prev_hist, by = c("plant_id")) %>% 
  mutate(subrgn_comparison = ifelse(egrid_subregion == subrgn_prev, "Same", 
                                    "Changed"),
         ba_comparison = ifelse(ba_name == ba_name_prev, "Y",
                                "N"),
         nerc_comparison = ifelse(nerc == nerc_prev, "Y",
                                  "N"),
         utility_id_comparison = ifelse(utility_id == utlsrvid_prev, "Y",
                                      "N")) %>%
  filter(subrgn_comparison != "Same") %>%
  left_join(plant_file_prev2_hist, by = c("plant_id"))

knitr::kable(plant_subregion_hist %>% 
               select(plant_id, egrid_subregion, subrgn_prev, subrgn_prev2, ba_comparison, nerc_comparison, utility_id_comparison))

```

## Mislabeled subregions

Map plants for each region and fix accordingly if needed.

```{r}
#| label: load-subregion-shapefile 
#| results: false

options(timeout = 180)

# download subregion shapefiles from EPA website
shp_download <- function(shp_type) {
  temp_file <- tempfile()
  download.file(glue::glue("https://www.epa.gov/system/files/other-files/2024-05/egrid2022_{tolower(shp_type)}_shapefile.zip"), temp_file)
  shp_file <- unzip(temp_file, exdir="data/1_production_model/shapefiles")
  unlink(temp_file)
  
  shp <- 
    sf::st_read(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/shapefiles/eGRID2022_{shp_type}.shp")) %>%
    drop_na() %>% 
    rename("subregion" = "ZipSubregi") %>% 
    sf::st_transform(crs = "EPSG:4326")
  return (shp)
}

if(length(list.files("data/shapefiles") == 1)) {
  sbrgn_shp <- shp_download("Subregions")
  multi_sbrgn_shp <- shp_download("Multiple_Subregions")
} else {
  sbrgn_shp <- 
    sf::st_read(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/shapefiles/eGRID2022_Subregions.shp")) %>%
    drop_na() %>% 
    rename("subregion" = "ZipSubregi") %>% 
    sf::st_transform(crs = "EPSG:4326")
  
  multi_sbrgn_shp <- 
    sf::st_read(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/shapefiles/eGRID2022_Multiple_Subregions.shp")) %>%
    drop_na() %>% 
    rename("subregion" = "ZipSubregi") %>% 
    sf::st_transform(crs = "EPSG:4326")
}

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# define bounding coordinates for plotting
bounding_box_plot <- function(plant_points) {
  if (nrow(plant_points)) {
    bounds <- list(c(sf::st_bbox(plant_points)[1] - 5, 
                               sf::st_bbox(plant_points)[3] + 5),
    c(sf::st_bbox(plant_points)[2] - 3, 
                               sf::st_bbox(plant_points)[4] + 3))
  } else {
     bounds <- list(c(-167, -70), c(25, 70))
  }
  return (bounds)
}
```

Check if plant locations are in regions. If there are any plants that are not in the region or in the overlapping regions, they will appear in the table. Some of the plants in the table may be due to being on the edge of region boundaries.

::: panel-tabset
### AKGD

```{r}
#| label: AKGD-map 

AKGD_plants <- 
  plant_with_coordinates %>% 
  filter(egrid_subregion == "AKGD") %>% 
  select(egrid_subregion, plant_id, primary_fuel_category, lat, lon) %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326") 

# create table of plants not in region or multi-region area
# rounding lat long may help capture edge case plants (that are just outside of boundary)
AKGD_shp <- 
  sbrgn_shp %>% 
  filter(subregion == "AKGD") %>% 
  sf::st_transform(crs = "EPSG:4326")

AKGD_plants <-
  AKGD_plants %>% 
  mutate(in_region_check = ifelse(plant_id %in% 
                        c(sf::st_filter(AKGD_plants, AKGD_shp)$plant_id),
                        TRUE, FALSE),
         multi_region_check = ifelse(plant_id %in% 
                        c(sf::st_filter(AKGD_plants, multi_sbrgn_shp)$plant_id),
                        TRUE, FALSE))

ifelse(nrow(AKGD_plants), glue::glue("{nrow(AKGD_plants)} plants in subregion"), 
       "No plants fall within subregion")

AKGD_outside <-
  AKGD_plants %>%
  filter(in_region_check == FALSE & multi_region_check == FALSE)

ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = sbrgn_shp, aes(fill = subregion)) + 
  geom_sf(data = multi_sbrgn_shp, aes(color = "Multi-region")) +
  geom_sf(data = AKGD_plants) +
  geom_sf(data = AKGD_outside, color = "red") +
  coord_sf(xlim = as.vector(bounding_box_plot(AKGD_plants)[[1]]),
           ylim = as.vector(bounding_box_plot(AKGD_plants)[[2]]),
           expand = TRUE)

ifelse(nrow(AKGD_outside) == 0, "No plants fall outside subregion and multi-region.", 
        glue::glue("{nrow(AKGD_outside)} plants fall outside region and subregion."))

knitr::kable(AKGD_outside) 

```

```{r}
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(sbrgn_shp))

MROE_shp <- 
  sbrgn_shp %>% 
  filter(subregion == "MROE") %>% 
  sf::st_transform(crs = "EPSG:4326")

MROE_plants <- 
  MROE_plants %>% 
  mutate(in_region_check = ifelse(plant_id %in% 
                        c(sf::st_filter(MROE_plants, MROE_shp)$plant_id),
                        TRUE, FALSE),
         multi_region_check = ifelse(plant_id %in% 
                        c(sf::st_filter(MROE_plants, multi_sbrgn_shp)$plant_id),
                        TRUE, FALSE))

ifelse(nrow(MROE_plants), glue::glue("{nrow(MROE_plants)} plants in subregion"),
       "No plants fall within subregion")

MROE_outside <-
  MROE_plants %>%
  filter(in_region_check == FALSE & multi_region_check == FALSE)

ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = sbrgn_shp, aes(fill = subregion)) +
  geom_sf(data = multi_sbrgn_shp, aes(color = "Multi-region")) +
  geom_sf(data = MROE_plants) +
  geom_sf(data = MROE_outside, color = "red") +
  coord_sf(xlim = as.vector(bounding_box_plot(MROE_plants)[[1]]),
           ylim = as.vector(bounding_box_plot(MROE_plants)[[2]]),
           expand = TRUE)

ifelse(nrow(MROE_outside) == 0, "No plants fall outside subregion and multi-region.", 
        glue::glue("{nrow(MROE_outside)} plants fall outside region and subregion."))

knitr::kable(MROE_outside) 
```

```{r}
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326") %>% 
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(sbrgn_shp))

SPSO_shp <- 
  sbrgn_shp %>% 
  filter(subregion == "SPSO") %>% 
  sf::st_transform(crs = "EPSG:4326")

SPSO_plants <- 
  SPSO_plants %>% 
  mutate(in_region_check = ifelse(plant_id %in% 
                        c(sf::st_filter(SPSO_plants, SPSO_shp)$plant_id),
                        TRUE, FALSE),
         multi_region_check = ifelse(plant_id %in% 
                        c(sf::st_filter(SPSO_plants, multi_sbrgn_shp)$plant_id),
                        TRUE, FALSE))

ifelse(nrow(SPSO_plants), glue::glue("{nrow(SPSO_plants)} plants in subregion"),
       "No plants fall within subregion")

SPSO_outside <-
  SPSO_plants %>%
  filter(in_region_check == FALSE & multi_region_check == FALSE)

ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = sbrgn_shp, aes(fill = subregion)) +
  geom_sf(data = multi_sbrgn_shp, aes(color = "Multi-region")) +
  geom_sf(data = SPSO_plants) +
  geom_sf(data = SPSO_outside, color = "red") +
  coord_sf(xlim = as.vector(bounding_box_plot(SPSO_plants)[[1]]),
           ylim = as.vector(bounding_box_plot(SPSO_plants)[[2]]),
                    expand = TRUE) 

ifelse(nrow(SPSO_outside) == 0, "No plants fall outside subregion and mulit-region.", 
        glue::glue("{nrow(SPSO_outside)} plants fall outside region and subregion."))

knitr::kable(SPSO_outside) 
```

## FC prime mover

FC prime mover should have no (NA) values for:

-   CO2

-   CH4

-   N2O

-   combustion heat input

```{r}
#| label: plant-fc-pm

# need to identify plants that ONLY have FC prime mover - and extract plant IDs

# plants assigned to FC
unit_fc_prime_mover <- 
  unit_file %>% 
  filter(prime_mover == "FC") %>% 
  distinct(plant_id) %>% 
  pull(plant_id) 

# plants assigned to FC AND another
unit_other_prime_mover <- 
  unit_file %>% 
  filter(plant_id %in% unit_fc_prime_mover) %>% 
  filter(!(prime_mover == "FC")) %>% 
  distinct(plant_id) %>% 
  pull(plant_id) 

# filter plants assigned ONLY to FC and have blank emissions and heat input
check_plant_fc_values <- 
  plant_file %>% 
  filter((plant_id %in% unit_fc_prime_mover & 
                          !(plant_id %in% unit_other_prime_mover)) &
                         (!is.na(co2_mass) | !is.na(ch4_mass) | !is.na(n2o_mass) | 
                          !is.na(combust_heat_input))) 

ifelse(nrow(check_plant_fc_values) == 0, "Status: PASS - All plants with ONLY FC prime mover have blank CO2, N2O, CH4, or annual combustion heat input data.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_fc_values)} plants with ONLY FC prime mover have values for CO2, N2O, CH4, or annual combustion heat input."))

knitr::kable(check_plant_fc_values %>% 
               select(plant_id, plant_name, co2_mass, 
                      ch4_mass, n2o_mass, combust_heat_input))

```

## Biomass adjustment emissions

We have columns labeled co2_biomass, ch4_biomass, etc. We want to make sure the value in that column is [not greater]{.underline} than the total unadjusted emissions (columns unadj_co2_mass, unadj_ch4_mass, etc.). We have a line of code that should set BIO columns to equal UN columns if it is larger, so want to check that is working.

```{r}
#| label: plant-biomass

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  check_plant_biomass_emissions <- 
    plant_file %>% 
    filter((nox_biomass > unadj_nox_mass) |
             #(nox_bio_oz > unadj_nox_oz_mass) |
             (so2_biomass > unadj_so2_mass) | 
             (co2_biomass > unadj_co2_mass) | 
             (ch4_biomass > unadj_ch4_mass) |
             (n2o_biomass > unadj_n2o_mass))
  
  ifelse(nrow(check_plant_biomass_emissions) == 0, "Status: PASS - No plants have biomass emissions greater than unadjusted emissions.", 
          glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_biomass_emissions)} plants have biomass emissions greater than unadjusted emissions."))
  
  knitr::kable(check_plant_biomass_emissions %>% 
                 select(plant_id, plant_name, unadj_nox_mass, 
                        nox_biomass, unadj_nox_oz_mass, #nox_bio_oz, 
                        unadj_so2_mass, so2_biomass, unadj_co2_mass, co2_biomass, 
                        unadj_ch4_mass, ch4_biomass, unadj_n2o_mass, n2o_biomass))
} else { 
    check_plant_biomass_emissions <- 
    plant_file %>% 
    filter((nox_biomass > unadj_nox_mass) |
             (so2_biomass > unadj_so2_mass) | 
             (co2_biomass > unadj_co2_mass) | 
             (ch4_biomass > unadj_ch4_mass) |
             (n2o_biomass > unadj_n2o_mass))
  
  ifelse(nrow(check_plant_biomass_emissions) == 0, "Status: PASS - No plants have biomass emissions greater than unadjusted emissions.", 
          glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_biomass_emissions)} plants have biomass emissions greater than unadjusted emissions."))
  
  knitr::kable(check_plant_biomass_emissions %>% 
                 select(plant_id, plant_name, unadj_nox_mass, nox_biomass, 
                        unadj_so2_mass, so2_biomass, unadj_co2_mass, co2_biomass, 
                        unadj_ch4_mass, ch4_biomass, unadj_n2o_mass, n2o_biomass))}

```

## Ozone emissions and heat input check

For this, we want to check that the NOx ozone season emissions are not greater than the annual NOx emissions (so columns PLnox_mass and PLnox_oz_mass). Same with annual heat input and ozone season heat input (PLheat_input and PLheat_input_oz/PLheat_inputT and PLheat_input_ozT).

```{r}
#| label: plant-ozone

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") {
  check_plant_ozone <- 
    plant_file %>% 
    filter((nox_mass < nox_oz_mass) |
           (heat_input < heat_input_oz) |
           (heat_input < heat_input_oz))
  
  ifelse(nrow(check_plant_ozone) == 0, "Status: PASS - No plants have ozone values greater than annual values", 
          glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_ozone)} plants have ozone values greater than annual values."))
  
  knitr::kable(check_plant_ozone %>% select(plant_id, plant_name, nox_mass, 
                                            nox_oz_mass, heat_input, heat_input_oz, 
                                            heat_input, heat_input_oz))
} else {
  print("Running monthly version so this does not apply.")
}

```

## Emission rate outliers

```{r}
#| label: calculate-stats

# output rates that are negative are typically zeroed out 
# here, we recalculate them and keep the negatives to identify outliers 

plant_rates <- 
  plant_file %>% 
  #select(plant_id, net_gen, heat_input, heat_input_oz, contains("rate")) # filter this way if using R plant file output
  select(plant_id, plant_name, primary_fuel_type, capfac, heat_input, heat_input_oz, generation, generation_oz, nox_mass, nox_oz_mass, so2_mass, co2_mass, ch4_mass,
         n2o_mass, co2e_mass, contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("perc_gen"), co2e_combust_out_rate) %>% 
  mutate(nox_output_rate = nox_mass / generation * 2000, 
         nox_oz_output_rate = nox_oz_mass / generation_oz * 2000, 
         so2_output_rate = so2_mass / generation * 2000, 
         co2_output_rate = co2_mass/ generation * 2000, 
         ch4_output_rate = ch4_mass / generation, 
         n2o_output_rate = n2o_mass / generation,
         co2e_output_rate = co2e_mass / generation * 2000) 

plant_rates[sapply(plant_rates, is.infinite)] <- NA

plant_stats <- 
  plant_rates %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = c(contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro")), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), -contains("average")), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd"),
         co2e_combust_out_rate_average = mean(co2e_combust_out_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
         co2e_combust_out_rate_sd = sd(co2e_combust_out_rate, na.rm = TRUE))

plant_stats[sapply(plant_stats, is.infinite)] <- NA

plant_zscore <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = c(contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), -contains("average"), -contains("sd")), 
                .fns = ~ (.x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_zscore"),
         co2e_combust_out_rate_zscore = (co2e_combust_out_rate - mean(co2e_combust_out_rate, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(co2e_combust_out_rate, na.rm = TRUE)) 
```

## Capacity factor

The capacity factor must be less than 1. Check if there are any instances of a capacity factor greater than 1.

```{r}
#| label: plant-cap-fac

check_plant_capfac <- 
  plant_file %>% 
  filter(capfac > 1.03)

ifelse(nrow(check_plant_capfac) == 0, "Status: PASS - No plants have capacity factor greater than 1.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_capfac)} plants have capacity factor greater than 1."))

knitr::kable(check_plant_capfac %>% 
               select(plant_id, plant_name, primary_fuel_category, primary_fuel_type, capfac, nameplate_capacity, generation))
```

```{r}
                        (primary_fuel_category == "COAL" & !(primary_fuel_type %in% 
                          c("ANT","BIT", "COG", "LIG", "RC", "SGC", "SUB", "WC"))) |
                        (primary_fuel_category == "GAS" & !(primary_fuel_type %in% c("NG", "PG"))) | 
                        (primary_fuel_category == "OIL" & !(primary_fuel_type %in% 
                          c("DFO", "JF", "KER", "PC", "RFO", "WO"))) | 
                        (primary_fuel_category == "OFSL" & !(primary_fuel_type %in% c("BFG", "OG", "TDF"))) |
                        (primary_fuel_category == "NUCLEAR" & !(primary_fuel_type == "NUC")) | 
                        (primary_fuel_category == "HYDRO" & !(primary_fuel_type == "WAT")) | 
                        (primary_fuel_category == "SOLAR" & !(primary_fuel_type == "SUN")) | 
                        (primary_fuel_category == "WIND" & !(primary_fuel_type == "WND")) | 
                        (primary_fuel_category == "GEOTHERMAL" & !(primary_fuel_type == "GEO")) | 
                        (primary_fuel_category == "OTHF" & !(primary_fuel_type %in% 
                          c("H", "MWH", "OTH", "PRG", "PUR", "WH"))) | 
                        (primary_fuel_category == "BIOMASS" & !(primary_fuel_type %in% 
                           c("AB", "BG", "BLQ", "DG", "LFG", "MSB", "MSW", "OBG", "OBL",
                             "OBS", "SLW", "WDL", "WDS"))))

ifelse(nrow(check_plant_fuelcat) == 0, "Status: PASS - All plants have a primary category and it matches the primary fuel.",
```

## Emissions without heat input

```{r}
#| label: plant-emissions-no-heatinput

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") {
  check_plant_emissions_heatinput <- 
    plant_file %>% 
    filter((is.na(heat_input) | is.na(heat_input_oz)) & 
            (nox_mass > 0 | nox_oz_mass > 0 | 
             so2_mass > 0 | co2_mass > 0 |
             ch4_mass > 0 | n2o_mass > 0 | 
             co2e_mass > 0))
} else { 
  check_plant_emissions_heatinput <- 
    plant_file %>% 
    filter((is.na(heat_input)) & 
            (nox_mass > 0 | 
             so2_mass > 0 | co2_mass > 0 |
             ch4_mass > 0 | n2o_mass > 0 | 
             co2e_mass > 0))}

ifelse(nrow(check_plant_emissions_heatinput) == 0, "Status: PASS - All plants with emission values have heat input values.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_emissions_heatinput)} plants that have emissions values are missing heat input."))

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  knitr::kable(check_plant_emissions_heatinput %>% 
                 select(plant_id, plant_name, heat_input, heat_input_oz, nox_mass, nox_oz_mass, 
                        so2_mass, co2_mass, ch4_mass, n2o_mass, co2e_mass))
} else { 
  knitr::kable(check_plant_emissions_heatinput %>% 
                 select(plant_id, plant_name, heat_input, nox_mass,  
                        so2_mass, co2_mass, ch4_mass, n2o_mass, co2e_mass))}

```

## Resource mix adds to 100

Confirm that the resource mix adds to 100%.

```{r}
#| label: plant-resource-mix

emission_types <- c(
  "_coal",
  "_oil",
  "_gas",
  "_nuclear",
  "_hydro",
  "_biomass",
  "_wind",
  "_solar",
  "_geothermal",
  "_other_ff",
  "_other"
)

plant_resource_mix <- 
  plant_file %>%
  select(plant_id, plant_name, contains("perc_gen") & !contains("non") & starts_with(emission_types)) %>%
  mutate(resource_mix_total = round(rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))), 3))

check_plant_resource_mix <- 
  plant_resource_mix %>% 
  filter(!(resource_mix_total == 1)) %>% 
  mutate()

ifelse(nrow(check_plant_resource_mix) == 0, "Status: PASS = All plant resource mixes add to 100%.", 
        glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_resource_mix)} plant resource mixes do not add to 100%."))

knitr::kable(check_plant_resource_mix %>% select(plant_id, plant_name,
                                                 resource_mix_total))

```

# Subregion File Only QA

## Outlier check for emission rate

```{r}
#| label: calculate-subregion-outliers

plant_stats_summary <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct() 

subregion_stats <- 
  subrgn_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, subregion_stats) 

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  subregion_zscore <- 
    subrgn_agg %>% 
    mutate(nox_output_zscore = (subregion_nox_output_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$nox_output_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$nox_output_rate_sd, 
           
           nox_oz_output_zscore = (subregion_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                     stats_summary$nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
           
           so2_output_zscore = (subregion_so2_output_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$so2_output_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$so2_output_rate_sd,
           
           co2_output_zscore = (subregion_co2_output_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$co2_output_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$co2_output_rate_sd,
           
           ch4_output_zscore = (subregion_ch4_output_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$ch4_output_rate_sd,
           
           n2o_output_zscore = (subregion_n2o_output_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$n2o_output_rate_sd,
           
           co2e_output_zscore = (subregion_co2e_output_rate - 
                                   stats_summary$co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$co2e_output_rate_sd,
           
           nox_input_zscore = (subregion_nox_input_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$nox_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$nox_input_rate_sd, 
           
           nox_oz_input_zscore = (subregion_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                     stats_summary$nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
           
           so2_input_zscore = (subregion_so2_input_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$so2_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$so2_input_rate_sd,
           
           co2_input_zscore = (subregion_co2_input_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$co2_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$co2_input_rate_sd,
           
           ch4_input_zscore = (subregion_ch4_input_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$ch4_input_rate_sd,
           
           n2o_input_zscore = (subregion_n2o_input_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_sd,
           
           co2e_input_zscore = (subregion_co2e_input_rate - 
                                   stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_sd) %>% 
    select(subregion, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
} else { 
  subregion_zscore <- 
    subrgn_agg %>% 
    mutate(nox_output_zscore = (subregion_nox_output_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$nox_output_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$nox_output_rate_sd, 
           so2_output_zscore = (subregion_so2_output_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$so2_output_rate_average)/

             stats_summary$ch4_input_rate_sd,
           
           n2o_input_zscore = (subregion_n2o_input_rate - 
                                  stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_sd,
           
           co2e_input_zscore = (subregion_co2e_input_rate - 
                                   stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
             stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_sd) %>% 
    select(subregion, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))}
```

# BA File QA

## Outlier check for emission rate

```{r}
#| label: calculate-ba-outliers

plant_stats_summary <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct() 

ba_stats <- 
  ba_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

ba_stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, ba_stats) 

ba_zscore <- 
  ba_agg %>% 
  mutate(nox_output_zscore = (ba_nox_output_rate - 
                        ba_stats_summary$nox_output_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$nox_output_rate_sd, 
  
  nox_oz_output_zscore = (ba_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                            ba_stats_summary$nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
  
  so2_output_zscore = (ba_so2_output_rate - 
                         ba_stats_summary$so2_output_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$so2_output_rate_sd,
  
  co2_output_zscore = (ba_co2_output_rate - 
                         ba_stats_summary$co2_output_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$co2_output_rate_sd,
  
  ch4_output_zscore = (ba_ch4_output_rate - 
                         ba_stats_summary$ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$ch4_output_rate_sd,
  
  n2o_output_zscore = (ba_n2o_output_rate - 
                         ba_stats_summary$n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$n2o_output_rate_sd,
  
  co2e_output_zscore = (ba_co2e_output_rate - 
                          ba_stats_summary$co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$co2e_output_rate_sd,
  
  nox_input_zscore = (ba_nox_input_rate - 
                        ba_stats_summary$nox_input_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$nox_input_rate_sd, 
  
  nox_oz_input_zscore = (ba_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                           ba_stats_summary$nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
  
  so2_input_zscore = (ba_so2_input_rate - 
                        ba_stats_summary$so2_input_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$so2_input_rate_sd,
  
  co2_input_zscore = (ba_co2_input_rate - 
                        ba_stats_summary$co2_input_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$co2_input_rate_sd,
  
  ch4_input_zscore = (ba_ch4_input_rate - 
                        ba_stats_summary$ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$ch4_input_rate_sd,
  
  n2o_input_zscore = (ba_n2o_input_rate - 
                        ba_stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_sd,
  
  co2e_input_zscore = (ba_co2e_input_rate - 
                         ba_stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
  ba_stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_sd) %>% 
  select(ba_name, ba_code, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
```

```{r}
           us_stats_summary$ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_zscore = (us_n2o_input_rate - 
                               us_stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_zscore = (us_co2e_input_rate - 
                                us_stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_sd) %>% 
  select(contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
```

# State file QA

## Outlier check for emission rate

```{r}

#| label: calculate-state-outliers  

plant_stats_summary <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct() 

state_stats <- 
  state_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct

state_stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, state_stats) 

state_zscore <- 
  state_agg %>% 
  mutate(nox_output_zscore = (state_nox_output_rate - 
                                state_stats_summary$nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_zscore = (state_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                   state_stats_summary$nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_zscore = (state_so2_output_rate - 
                                state_stats_summary$so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_zscore = (state_co2_output_rate - 
                                state_stats_summary$co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_zscore = (state_ch4_output_rate - 
                                state_stats_summary$ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_zscore = (state_n2o_output_rate - 
                                state_stats_summary$n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_zscore = (state_co2e_output_rate - 
                                 state_stats_summary$co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_zscore = (state_nox_input_rate - 
                               state_stats_summary$nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_zscore = (state_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                  state_stats_summary$nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_zscore = (state_so2_input_rate - 
                               state_stats_summary$so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_zscore = (state_co2_input_rate - 
                               state_stats_summary$co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_zscore = (state_ch4_input_rate - 
                               state_stats_summary$ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_zscore = (state_n2o_input_rate - 
                               state_stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_zscore = (state_co2e_input_rate - 
                                state_stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats_summary$co2e_input_rate_sd) %>% 
  select(state, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
```

# Subregion File Fuel Specific QA

## Outlier check for fuel emission rates

```{r}
#| label: calculate-subregion-fuel-outliers

plant_stats_summary <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct() 

subregion_stats <- 
  subrgn_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, subregion_stats) 

subregion_fuel_zscore <- 
  subrgn_agg %>% 
  mutate(nox_output_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_nox_output_rate - 
                                     subregion_stats$subregion_coal_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                        subregion_stats$subregion_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_so2_output_rate - 
                                     subregion_stats$subregion_coal_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_co2_output_rate - 
                                     subregion_stats$subregion_coal_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_ch4_output_rate - 
                                     subregion_stats$subregion_coal_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_n2o_output_rate - 
                                     subregion_stats$subregion_coal_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_co2e_output_rate - 
                                      subregion_stats$subregion_coal_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_nox_input_rate - 
                                    subregion_stats$subregion_coal_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                       subregion_stats$subregion_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_so2_input_rate - 
                                    subregion_stats$subregion_coal_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_co2_input_rate - 
                                    subregion_stats$subregion_coal_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_ch4_input_rate - 
                                    subregion_stats$subregion_coal_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_n2o_input_rate - 
                                    subregion_stats$subregion_coal_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_coal_zscore = (subregion_coal_co2e_input_rate - 
                                     subregion_stats$subregion_coal_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_coal_co2e_input_rate_sd,
         
         # oil calculations for z score
  
        nox_output_oil_zscore = (subregion_oil_nox_output_rate - 
                                     subregion_stats$subregion_oil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           subregion_stats$subregion_oil_nox_output_rate_sd,

           subregion_stats$subregion_oil_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_oil_zscore = (subregion_oil_co2_input_rate -
```

# NERC File Fuel Specific QA

## Outlier check for fuel emission rates

```{r}
#| label: calculate-nerc-fuel-outliers

plant_stats_summary <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct() 

nerc_stats <- 
  nerc_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

nerc_stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, nerc_stats) 

nerc_fuel_zscore <- 
  nerc_agg %>% 
  mutate(nox_output_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_nox_output_rate - 
                                     nerc_stats$nerc_coal_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                        nerc_stats$nerc_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_so2_output_rate - 
                                     nerc_stats$nerc_coal_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_co2_output_rate - 
                                     nerc_stats$nerc_coal_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_ch4_output_rate - 
                                     nerc_stats$nerc_coal_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_n2o_output_rate - 
                                     nerc_stats$nerc_coal_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_co2e_output_rate - 
                                      nerc_stats$nerc_coal_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_nox_input_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_coal_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_so2_input_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_coal_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_co2_input_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_coal_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_ch4_input_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_coal_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_n2o_input_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_coal_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_coal_zscore = (nerc_coal_co2e_input_rate - 
                                     nerc_stats$nerc_coal_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_coal_co2e_input_rate_sd,
         
         # oil calculations for z score
         
         nox_output_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_nox_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_oil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_oil_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_so2_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_oil_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_co2_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_oil_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_ch4_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_oil_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_n2o_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_oil_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_co2e_output_rate - 
                                     nerc_stats$nerc_oil_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_nox_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_oil_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                      nerc_stats$nerc_oil_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_so2_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_oil_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_co2_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_oil_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_ch4_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_oil_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_n2o_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_oil_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_oil_zscore = (nerc_oil_co2e_input_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_oil_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_oil_co2e_input_rate_sd, 
         
         # gas calculations for z score
         
         nox_output_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_nox_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_gas_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_gas_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_so2_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_gas_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_co2_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_gas_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_ch4_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_gas_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_n2o_output_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_gas_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_co2e_output_rate - 
                                     nerc_stats$nerc_gas_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_nox_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_gas_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                      nerc_stats$nerc_gas_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_so2_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_gas_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_co2_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_gas_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_ch4_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_gas_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_n2o_input_rate - 
                                   nerc_stats$nerc_gas_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_gas_zscore = (nerc_gas_co2e_input_rate - 
                                    nerc_stats$nerc_gas_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_gas_co2e_input_rate_sd, 
         
         # calculations for fossil fuel z score
         
         nox_output_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_nox_output_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                          nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_so2_output_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_co2_output_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_ch4_output_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_n2o_output_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_co2e_output_rate - 
                                        nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_nox_input_rate - 
                                      nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                         nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_so2_input_rate - 
                                      nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_co2_input_rate - 
                                      nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_ch4_input_rate - 
                                      nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_n2o_input_rate - 
                                      nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_fossil_zscore = (nerc_fossil_co2e_input_rate - 
                                       nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           nerc_stats$nerc_fossil_co2e_input_rate_sd) %>%
  select(nerc, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
```

# BA File Fuel Specific QA

## Outlier check for fuel emissions rate

```{r}
#| label: calculate-ba-fuel-outliers

plant_stats_summary <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct() 

ba_stats <- 
  ba_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

ba_stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, ba_stats) 

ba_fuel_zscore <- 
  ba_agg %>% 
  mutate(nox_output_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_nox_output_rate - 
                                     ba_stats$ba_coal_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                        ba_stats$ba_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_so2_output_rate - 
                                     ba_stats$ba_coal_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_co2_output_rate - 
                                     ba_stats$ba_coal_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_ch4_output_rate - 
                                     ba_stats$ba_coal_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_n2o_output_rate - 
                                     ba_stats$ba_coal_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_co2e_output_rate - 
                                      ba_stats$ba_coal_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_nox_input_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_coal_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                       ba_stats$ba_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_so2_input_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_coal_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_co2_input_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_coal_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_ch4_input_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_coal_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_n2o_input_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_coal_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_coal_zscore = (ba_coal_co2e_input_rate - 
                                     ba_stats$ba_coal_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_coal_co2e_input_rate_sd,
         
         # oil calculations for z score
         
         nox_output_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_nox_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_oil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                       ba_stats$ba_oil_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_so2_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_oil_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_co2_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_oil_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_ch4_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_oil_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_n2o_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_oil_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_co2e_output_rate - 
                                     ba_stats$ba_oil_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_nox_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_oil_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                      ba_stats$ba_oil_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_so2_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_oil_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_co2_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_oil_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_ch4_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_oil_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_n2o_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_oil_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_oil_zscore = (ba_oil_co2e_input_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_oil_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_oil_co2e_input_rate_sd, 
         
         # gas calculations for z score
         
         nox_output_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_nox_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_gas_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                       ba_stats$ba_gas_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_so2_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_gas_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_co2_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_gas_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_ch4_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_gas_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_n2o_output_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_gas_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_co2e_output_rate - 
                                     ba_stats$ba_gas_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_nox_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_gas_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                      ba_stats$ba_gas_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_so2_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_gas_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_co2_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_gas_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_ch4_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_gas_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_n2o_input_rate - 
                                   ba_stats$ba_gas_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_gas_zscore = (ba_gas_co2e_input_rate - 
                                    ba_stats$ba_gas_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_gas_co2e_input_rate_sd, 
         
         # calculations for fossil fuel z score
         
         nox_output_fossil_zscore = (ba_fossil_nox_output_rate - 
                                       ba_stats$ba_fossil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_fossil_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_fossil_zscore = (ba_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                          ba_stats$ba_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_fossil_zscore = (ba_fossil_so2_output_rate - 
                                       ba_stats$ba_fossil_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           ba_stats$ba_fossil_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_fossil_zscore = (ba_fossil_co2_output_rate -

         n2o_output_fossil_zscore = (ba_fossil_n2o_output_rate -

           ba_stats$ba_fossil_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_fossil_zscore = (ba_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate -
```
