# US File Fuel Specific QA

## Outlier check for fuel emission rates

```{r}
#| label: calculate-us-fuel-outliers

plant_stats_summary <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct() 

us_stats <- 
  us_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

us_stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, us_stats) 

us_fuel_zscore <- 
  us_agg %>% 
  mutate(nox_output_coal_zscore = (us_coal_nox_output_rate - 
                                     us_stats$us_coal_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_coal_zscore = (us_coal_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                        us_stats$us_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_coal_zscore = (us_coal_so2_output_rate - 
                                     us_stats$us_coal_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_coal_zscore = (us_coal_co2_output_rate - 
                                     us_stats$us_coal_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_coal_zscore = (us_coal_ch4_output_rate - 
                                     us_stats$us_coal_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_coal_zscore = (us_coal_n2o_output_rate - 
                                     us_stats$us_coal_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_coal_zscore = (us_coal_co2e_output_rate - 
                                      us_stats$us_coal_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_coal_zscore = (us_coal_nox_input_rate - 
                                    us_stats$us_coal_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_coal_zscore = (us_coal_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                       us_stats$us_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_coal_zscore = (us_coal_so2_input_rate - 
                                    us_stats$us_coal_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_coal_zscore = (us_coal_co2_input_rate - 
                                    us_stats$us_coal_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_coal_zscore = (us_coal_ch4_input_rate - 
                                    us_stats$us_coal_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_coal_zscore = (us_coal_n2o_input_rate - 
                                    us_stats$us_coal_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_coal_zscore = (us_coal_co2e_input_rate - 
                                     us_stats$us_coal_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_coal_co2e_input_rate_sd,
         
         # oil calculations for z score
         
         nox_output_oil_zscore = (us_oil_nox_output_rate - 
                                    us_stats$us_oil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_oil_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_oil_zscore = (us_oil_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                       us_stats$us_oil_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/

           us_stats$us_gas_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_gas_zscore = (us_gas_n2o_input_rate - 
                                   us_stats$us_gas_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_gas_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_gas_zscore = (us_gas_co2e_input_rate - 
                                    us_stats$us_gas_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_gas_co2e_input_rate_sd, 
         
         # calculations for fossil fuel z score
         
         nox_output_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_nox_output_rate - 
                                       us_stats$us_fossil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                          us_stats$us_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_so2_output_rate - 
                                       us_stats$us_fossil_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_co2_output_rate - 
                                       us_stats$us_fossil_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_ch4_output_rate - 
                                       us_stats$us_fossil_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_n2o_output_rate - 
                                       us_stats$us_fossil_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_co2e_output_rate - 
                                        us_stats$us_fossil_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_nox_input_rate - 
                                      us_stats$us_fossil_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                         us_stats$us_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_so2_input_rate - 
                                      us_stats$us_fossil_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_co2_input_rate - 
                                      us_stats$us_fossil_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_ch4_input_rate - 
                                      us_stats$us_fossil_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_n2o_input_rate - 
                                      us_stats$us_fossil_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_fossil_zscore = (us_fossil_co2e_input_rate - 
                                       us_stats$us_fossil_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           us_stats$us_fossil_co2e_input_rate_sd) %>%
  select(contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
```

# State File Fuel Specific QA

## Outlier check for fuel emissions rate

```{r}
#| label: calculate-state-fuel-outliers

plant_stats_summary <- 
  plant_stats %>% 
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct() 

state_stats <- 
  state_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

state_stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, state_stats) 

state_fuel_zscore <- 
  state_agg %>% 
  mutate(nox_output_coal_zscore = (state_coal_nox_output_rate - 
                                     state_stats$state_coal_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_coal_zscore = (state_coal_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                        state_stats$state_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_coal_zscore = (state_coal_so2_output_rate - 
                                     state_stats$state_coal_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_coal_zscore = (state_coal_co2_output_rate - 
                                     state_stats$state_coal_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_coal_zscore = (state_coal_ch4_output_rate - 
                                     state_stats$state_coal_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_coal_zscore = (state_coal_n2o_output_rate - 
                                     state_stats$state_coal_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_coal_zscore = (state_coal_co2e_output_rate - 
                                      state_stats$state_coal_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_coal_zscore = (state_coal_nox_input_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_coal_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_coal_zscore = (state_coal_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_coal_zscore = (state_coal_so2_input_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_coal_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_coal_zscore = (state_coal_co2_input_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_coal_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_coal_zscore = (state_coal_ch4_input_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_coal_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_coal_zscore = (state_coal_n2o_input_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_coal_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_coal_zscore = (state_coal_co2e_input_rate - 
                                     state_stats$state_coal_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_coal_co2e_input_rate_sd,
         
         # oil calculations for z score
         
         nox_output_oil_zscore = (state_oil_nox_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_oil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_oil_zscore = (state_oil_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_oil_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_oil_zscore = (state_oil_so2_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_oil_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_oil_zscore = (state_oil_co2_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_oil_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_oil_zscore = (state_oil_ch4_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_oil_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_oil_zscore = (state_oil_n2o_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_oil_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_oil_zscore = (state_oil_co2e_output_rate - 
                                     state_stats$state_oil_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_oil_zscore = (state_oil_nox_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_oil_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_oil_zscore = (state_oil_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                      state_stats$state_oil_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_oil_zscore = (state_oil_so2_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_oil_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_oil_zscore = (state_oil_co2_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_oil_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_oil_zscore = (state_oil_ch4_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_oil_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_oil_zscore = (state_oil_n2o_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_oil_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_oil_zscore = (state_oil_co2e_input_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_oil_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_oil_co2e_input_rate_sd, 
         
         # gas calculations for z score
         
         nox_output_gas_zscore = (state_gas_nox_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_gas_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_gas_zscore = (state_gas_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_gas_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_gas_zscore = (state_gas_so2_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_gas_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_gas_zscore = (state_gas_co2_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_gas_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_gas_zscore = (state_gas_ch4_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_gas_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_gas_zscore = (state_gas_n2o_output_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_gas_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_gas_zscore = (state_gas_co2e_output_rate - 
                                     state_stats$state_gas_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_gas_zscore = (state_gas_nox_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_gas_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_gas_zscore = (state_gas_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                      state_stats$state_gas_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_gas_zscore = (state_gas_so2_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_gas_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_gas_zscore = (state_gas_co2_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_gas_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_gas_zscore = (state_gas_ch4_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_gas_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_gas_zscore = (state_gas_n2o_input_rate - 
                                   state_stats$state_gas_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_gas_zscore = (state_gas_co2e_input_rate - 
                                    state_stats$state_gas_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_gas_co2e_input_rate_sd, 
         
         # calculations for fossil fuel z score
         
         nox_output_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_nox_output_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_fossil_nox_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_nox_output_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_output_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate - 
                                          state_stats$state_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_nox_oz_output_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_output_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_so2_output_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_fossil_so2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_so2_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2_output_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_co2_output_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_fossil_co2_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_co2_output_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_output_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_ch4_output_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_fossil_ch4_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_ch4_output_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_output_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_n2o_output_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_fossil_n2o_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_n2o_output_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_output_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_co2e_output_rate - 
                                        state_stats$state_fossil_co2e_output_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_co2e_output_rate_sd,
         
         nox_input_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_nox_input_rate - 
                                      state_stats$state_fossil_nox_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_nox_input_rate_sd, 
         
         nox_oz_input_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate - 
                                         state_stats$state_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_nox_oz_input_rate_sd, 
         
         so2_input_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_so2_input_rate - 
                                      state_stats$state_fossil_so2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_so2_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2_input_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_co2_input_rate - 
                                      state_stats$state_fossil_co2_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_co2_input_rate_sd,
         
         ch4_input_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_ch4_input_rate - 
                                      state_stats$state_fossil_ch4_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_ch4_input_rate_sd,
         
         n2o_input_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_n2o_input_rate - 
                                      state_stats$state_fossil_n2o_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_n2o_input_rate_sd,
         
         co2e_input_fossil_zscore = (state_fossil_co2e_input_rate - 
                                       state_stats$state_fossil_co2e_input_rate_average)/ 
           state_stats$state_fossil_co2e_input_rate_sd) %>%
  select(state, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
```

# Subregion Nonbaseload QA

## Outlier check for nonbaseload emisisons

```{r}
#| label: calculate-subregion-nonbaseload-outliers

plant_stats_summary <-
  plant_stats %>%
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct()

subregion_stats <- 
  subrgn_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, subregion_stats) 

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  
  subregion_nonbaseload_zscore <- 
    subrgn_agg %>% 
    mutate(nox_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_nox_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_nox_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_nox_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           nox_oz_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_nox_output_rate_nonbaseload - 
                                                 stats_summary$subregion_nox_oz_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_nox_oz_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           so2_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_so2_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_so2_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_so2_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           co2_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_co2_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_co2_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_co2_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,

           ch4_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_ch4_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_ch4_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_ch4_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           n2o_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_n2o_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                             stats_summary$subregion_n2o_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_n2o_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           co2e_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_co2e_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                             stats_summary$subregion_co2e_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_co2e_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd) %>%
    select(subregion, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
} else { 
  subregion_nonbaseload_zscore <- 
    subrgn_agg %>% 
    mutate(nox_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_nox_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_nox_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_nox_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           nox_oz_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_nox_output_rate_nonbaseload - 
                                                 stats_summary$subregion_nox_oz_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_nox_oz_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           so2_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_so2_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_so2_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_so2_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           co2_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_co2_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_co2_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_co2_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           ch4_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_ch4_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_ch4_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_ch4_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           n2o_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_n2o_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                              stats_summary$subregion_n2o_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_n2o_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd,
           
           co2e_nonbaseload_output_zscore = (subregion_co2e_output_rate_nonbaseload -
                                               stats_summary$subregion_co2e_output_rate_nonbaseload_average)/
             stats_summary$subregion_co2e_output_rate_nonbaseload_sd) %>%
    select(subregion, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))}

```

# BA Combustion QA

## Outlier check for combustion emisisons

```{r}
#| label: calculate-ba-combustion-outliers

plant_stats_summary <-
  plant_stats %>%
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct()

ba_combustion_stats <- 
  ba_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

ba_combustion_stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, ba_combustion_stats) 

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  
  ba_combustion_zscore <- 
    ba_agg %>% 
    mutate(nox_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_nox_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_nox_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_nox_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           nox_oz_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_nox_combustion_rate - 
                                                ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_nox_oz_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_nox_oz_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           so2_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_so2_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_so2_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_so2_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           co2_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_co2_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_co2_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_co2_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           ch4_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_ch4_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_ch4_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_ch4_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           n2o_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_n2o_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_n2o_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_n2o_combustion_rate_sd,

             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_co2e_combustion_rate_sd) %>%
    select(ba_code, contains("rate"), contains("ra"), contains("ro"), contains("zscore"))
} else { 
  ba_nonbaseload_zscore <- 
    subrgn_agg %>% 
    mutate(nox_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_nox_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_nox_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_nox_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           nox_oz_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_nox_combustion_rate - 
                                                ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_nox_oz_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_nox_oz_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           so2_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_so2_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_so2_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_so2_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           co2_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_co2_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_co2_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_co2_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           ch4_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_ch4_combustion_rate -
                                             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_ch4_combustion_rate_average)/
             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_ch4_combustion_rate_sd,
           
           n2o_combustion_output_zscore = (ba_n2o_combustion_rate -

             ba_combustion_stats_summary$ba_n2o_combustion_rate_sd,
```

# US Combustion QA

```{r}
#| label: calculate-us-combustion-outliers

plant_stats_summary <-
  plant_stats %>%
  select(contains("average"), contains("sd")) %>% distinct()

us_combustion_stats <- 
  us_agg %>% 
  mutate(across(.cols = contains("rate") & where(is.numeric), 
                .fns = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_average"), 
         across(.cols = c(contains("rate") & where(is.numeric),
                          -contains("average") & where(is.numeric)), 
                .fns = ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
                .names =  "{.col}_sd")) %>% 
  select(contains("average") & where(is.numeric), 
         contains("sd") & where(is.numeric)) %>% distinct()

us_combustion_stats_summary <- bind_cols(plant_stats_summary, us_combustion_stats) 

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  
  us_combustion_zscore <- 
    us_agg %>% 
    mutate(nox_combustion_output_zscore = (us_nox_combustion_rate -
                                             us_combustion_stats_summary$us_nox_combustion_rate_average)/
             us_combustion_stats_summary$us_nox_combustion_rate_sd,
```

# All file QA

## Count of plants in generator, unit, and plant file are equivalent

```{r}
#| label: count-plants

gen_plants <-
  generator_file %>%
  distinct(plant_id)

if (nrow(gen_plants) < nrow(plant_file %>% distinct(plant_id))) {
  gen_missing_plants <-
    plant_file %>%
    distinct(plant_id) %>% 
    filter(!plant_id %in% gen_plants$plant_id)
  print(glue::glue("Missing {nrow(gen_missing_plants)} plants in generator file."))
  print(knitr::kable(gen_missing_plants))
} else {
  "No missing plants in generator file"
}

unit_plants <-
  unit_file %>%
  distinct(plant_id)

if (nrow(unit_plants) < nrow(plant_file %>% distinct(plant_id))) {
  unit_missing_plants <-
    plant_file %>%
    distinct(plant_id) %>% 
    filter(!plant_id %in% unit_plants$plant_id)
  print(glue::glue("Missing {nrow(unit_missing_plants)} plants in unit file."))
  print(knitr::kable(unit_missing_plants))
} else {
  "No missing plants in unit file"
}

```

## Sum of generation

Check that generation is equal across plant and generator file.

### Plant by plant comparisons - annual generation

```{r}
#| label: plant-annual-generation

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") { 
  gen_plant_sum <-
    generator_file %>%
    group_by(pick(all_of(temporal_res_cols)), plant_id) %>%
    summarize(plant_ann_sum = sum(generation, na.rm = TRUE), 
              plant_oz_sum = sum(generation_oz, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
    ungroup()
  
} else { 
  gen_plant_sum <-
    generator_file %>%
    group_by(pick(all_of(temporal_res_cols)), plant_id) %>%
    summarize(plant_ann_sum = sum(generation, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
    ungroup()}

check_plant_gen_sum_ann <- gen_plant_sum %>%
  full_join(plant_file %>% select("plant_id", "generation"), join_by("plant_id")) %>%
  mutate(sum_diff = round(generation - plant_ann_sum, 5),
         perc_diff = (sum_diff)/((generation + plant_ann_sum)/2)*100) %>%
  filter(sum_diff != 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(sum_diff))

ifelse(nrow(check_plant_gen_sum_ann) == 0, "Status: PASS - All annual generation values between plant and generation files are equal.",glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_gen_sum_ann)} plants do not have the same annual plant generation values between plant and generation files."))

knitr::kable(check_plant_gen_sum_ann %>% select(plant_id, sum_diff, generation, plant_ann_sum, perc_diff))
```

### Plant by plant comparison - ozone season generation

```{r}
#| label: plant-ozone-generation

if (params$temporal_res == "annual") {
  check_plant_gen_sum_oz <- 
    gen_plant_sum %>%
    full_join(plant_file %>% select(plant_id, generation_oz), join_by("plant_id")) %>%
    mutate(sum_diff = round(generation_oz - plant_oz_sum, 5)) %>%
    filter(sum_diff != 0)
  
  ifelse(nrow(check_plant_gen_sum_oz) == 0, "Status: PASS - All annual generation values between plant and generation files are equal.",glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(check_plant_gen_sum_oz)} plants do not have the same annual plant generation values between plant and generation files."))
  
  knitr::kable(check_plant_gen_sum_oz %>% select(plant_id, sum_diff))
} else {
  print("Running monthly version so this does not apply.")
}
```

### Total generation comaprisons - Plant file vs Generator file

```{r}
#| label: plant-generator-total-generation

plant_generation <- 
  plant_file %>%
  distinct(plant_id, generation, year) %>%
  group_by(plant_id, year) %>%
  summarize(plant_gen_total = sum(generation, na.rm = TRUE))

generator_generation <- 
  generator_file %>%
  group_by(plant_id, year) %>%
  summarize(generator_gen_total = sum(generation, na.rm = TRUE))

compare_plant_generator_gen <- 
  left_join(plant_generation, generator_generation, by = c("year", "plant_id")) %>%
  mutate(diff = abs(plant_gen_total - generator_gen_total)) %>%
  filter(diff > 2)

ifelse(nrow(compare_plant_generator_gen) == 0, "Status: PASS - All annual generation values between plant and generation files are equal.",
       glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - {nrow(compare_plant_generator_gen)} plants do not have the same annual plant generation values between plant and generator files. The generation values in the generator file for these plants were overwritten."))

knitr::kable(compare_plant_generator_gen %>% select(plant_id, plant_gen_total, generator_gen_total, diff))


```

## Data year correct in excel output

May need to do some checks manually.

```{r}
#| label: load-excel-data

excel_load <- function(filename) {
  sheets <- excel_sheets(filename)
  all_sheets <- lapply(sheets, function(X) read_excel(filename, sheet = X, skip = 1))
  names(all_sheets) <- sheets
  return (all_sheets)
}

data_excel <- excel_load(glue::glue("data/1_production_model/outputs/{params$year}/egrid{params$year}_data.xlsx"))
unit_excel <- data_excel[[glue::glue("UNT{params$year_abbrev}")]]
plant_excel <- data_excel[[glue::glue("PLNT{params$year_abbrev}")]]
gen_excel <- data_excel[[glue::glue("GEN{params$year_abbrev}")]]
```

```{r}
#| label: excel-output-year

years_check <-
  rbind(unit_excel["YEAR"],
        plant_excel["YEAR"],
        gen_excel["YEAR"],
        data_excel[[glue::glue("ST{params$year_abbrev}")]]["YEAR"],
        data_excel[[glue::glue("BA{params$year_abbrev}")]]["YEAR"],
        data_excel[[glue::glue("SRL{params$year_abbrev}")]]["YEAR"],
        data_excel[[glue::glue("NRL{params$year_abbrev}")]]["YEAR"],
        data_excel[[glue::glue("US{params$year_abbrev}")]]["YEAR"]) %>%
  filter(YEAR != params$year)


ifelse(nrow(years_check) == 0, "Status: PASS - Excel data year is correct in all instances.", glue::glue("Status: NEEDS CHECKED - Excel data year is not correct in {sum(c(nrow(unit_years_check),nrow(plant_years_check),nrow(generator_years_check)))} instances."))

```
